श्मील् श्मील् (also written स्मील्; cf. rt.
मील्), cl. 1. P. श्मीलति, श्मीलितुम्,
to wink, contract the eyelids; to twinkle.

स्मील् स्मील् (= rt. श्मील्, p. 1023; cf. rt.
मील्), cl. 1. P. स्मीलति, &c., to wink,
blink.

श्मीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, winked, blinked; (अम्), n. a
wink, winking.

स्मि स्मि, cl. 1. A. स्मयते (ep. also P.
-ति), सिष्मिये, स्मेष्यते, अस्मेष्ट,
स्मेतुम्, to smile, laugh; to expand, bloom (as a
flower): Pass. स्मीयते, Aor. अस्मायि: Caus. स्मा-
ययति, -ते (also स्मापयते in वि-स्मि, q. v.), to
cause to laugh, provoke or excite laughter; (A.) to
laugh at, mock, despise: Desid. सिस्मयिषते:
Intens. सेष्मीयते, (in Mālavikāgnimitra, Act IV,
the Prākṛt सिमिसिमा-अन्ति [see s.v.] is incorrectly
referred to the Intens. of rt. स्मि), सेष्मयीति, सेष्-
मेति; [cf. Gr. μεῖ-δ-ος, μεί-δ-η-μα, μει-δ-ά-ω,
μει-διάω, (perhaps also) σμοιός. μέμφομαι, μῶμος:
Lat. mi-ru-s, ni-miru-m, mira-ri: Old Germ.
smie-l-en, smie-r-en: Eng. smile: Angl. Sax.
smœrc: Slav. sme-ja-ti, po-sme-chu: Lett. smee-t:
Hib. smigeadh, magadh, ‘mocking;’ magamhuil,
‘jeering.’]

स्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, smiled, smiling; expanded,
blown, blossomed; (अम्), n. a smile, gentle laugh.
—स्मित-दृश्, क्, f. ‘having a smiling look,’ a hand-
some woman.
—स्मित-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by
a smile; (अम्), ind. with a smile, smilingly.
—स्मित-
पूर्वाभिभाषिन् (˚व-अभ्˚), ई, इणी, इ, addressing
with a smile.
—स्मित-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having smiles,
smiling, laughing.
—स्मित-शोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, smiling
beautifully.
स्मिति, इस्, f. smiling, a smile, laughter.
स्मित्वा, ind. having smiled or laughed.

स्मिट् स्मिट् (connected with rt. स्मि),
cl. 10. P. स्मेटयति, &c., to slight,
despise; to love; to go.
